title: Diagnose the Data Center
summary: Use systems thinking to explain a low-risk infrastructure problem and recommend a safe next step.
objectives: Identify symptoms and a likely affected subsystem.
Use evidence to explain possible causes and communicate a safe recommendation.

vocab.def: A limit or condition that a solution must respect.
A reasoned suggestion about what should happen next.
Looking at parts, connections, and effects as one larger system.

sections.heading: Your systems challenge
sections.body: Choose a classroom-safe scenario: a powered server cannot reach the network; several racks show high temperature; or equipment loses power during an interruption. Identify the symptoms and affected system.

sections.heading: Build an evidence explanation
sections.body: Show the relevant components and connections in a diagram or outline. Name possible causes, distinguish observations from guesses, and recommend a safe next step such as checking approved information or asking a qualified adult.

sections.heading: Explain your reasoning
sections.body: Your work should show how systems depend on each other. It is an educational model, not a repair plan. Do not open equipment, wire circuits, handle live fiber, service cooling, or bypass security.

practice.prompt: Before presenting, check that your explanation includes a symptom, affected system, evidence, possible cause, constraint, and safe recommendation.

project.title: Systems Troubleshooting Challenge
submissionOptions: written scenario response with a systems diagram
accessible digital outline with labeled connections
oral explanation paired with a labeled visual
rubric: uses evidence and separates observation from assumption

quiz.question: What is the goal of the systems challenge?
options: Explain a possible cause using evidence and a safe next step
quiz.answer: Explain a possible cause using evidence and a safe next step

levels: Developing: connects a symptom to a system with some evidence
Proficient: explains connected systems, evidence, constraints, and a safe recommendation

reflectionPrompt: Which system connection helped you reason through the challenge, and what would you want to learn next?
